crossRefs.note: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

translations.web: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
translations.bsb: He laughs at fear, frightened of nothing; he does not turn back from the sword.
translations.kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
translations.asv: He mocketh at fear, and is not dismayed; Neither turneth he back from the sword.
